facts.fact: 开篇立论：纸作为武器源于 Kayla 的纸割之名，人人挨过纸割都知道有多痛
facts.anchor: Most people don’t think of paper as a weapon; they think of knives and guns and all the obvious things

facts.fact: 计数悖论：Vero 已数不清纸割刀数，只数得出用纸张数——且后者更少
facts.anchor: I have lost count of the number of paper cuts we are at, but I know how many pieces of paper I have used, and that is a smaller number

facts.fact: 纸割供血不足时他改用螺丝刀捅刺——刑具升级的冷静理由
facts.anchor: I may have stabbed him at one stage with a screwdriver because the paper cuts were not producing enough blood

facts.fact: Aaron 抛出「她也爱过我」，Vero 罕见停顿
facts.anchor: She loved me once as well

facts.fact: Vero 的爱的定义：爱不等于所有权，离开不等于有错——他刚学会这一条
facts.anchor: But love doesn’t make someone yours. It’s not ownership, and it doesn’t mean when they leave it’s wrong—I just learned that one

facts.fact: 反击 Aaron：Kayla 清楚 Vero 是什么仍选择留下，而 Aaron 把她装进土里她仍爬了出来
facts.anchor: She also knows, and still she chooses to stay

facts.fact: Vero 自陈：我不是怪物，但我要这事拖很久——感染会不公平地提前结束
facts.anchor: I’m not a monster, but I want this to take a long time

facts.fact: 发作中的清醒夹层：Vero 罕见自认躁狂，与自我解离并存
facts.anchor: I’m a little manic. I don’t usually feel this mid-episode, but I can this time, stuck somewhere in between
